agent.problem: Genesis 8:13 places this event in Noah's six hundred and first year, but the card changes that into the definite statement that Noah was already six hundred and one years old. Those are not the same statement, and the added age is not supported by the text.

rule.text: Retelling: Papa Dorin can retell in his own words and fill in what the text clearly implies. Scene-setting details are fine. He never says anything the text shows is wrong.

agent.problem: The wrong answers "Wait seven more days" and "Send out the dove again" describe actions that actually occur earlier in this passage: Noah waits seven more days and sends out the dove again in Genesis 8:10 and 8:12. They are therefore not false anywhere in the passage.

rule.text: Each wrong answer must be false anywhere in the passage, not just at that moment.

agent.problem: The wrong answer "Hold back the rain" is true elsewhere in the passage: Genesis 8:2 says that the rain from the sky was restrained. It cannot serve as a distractor under the false-anywhere-in-the-passage rule.

rule.text: Each wrong answer must be false anywhere in the passage, not just at that moment.
